To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

• We present a novel attack model in which an attacker can bridge an air-gapped computer network by using a covert thermal communication channel that is established through the air-conditioning system.

(i) We show how an attacker can use a compromised air-conditioning system to send commands to a computer in an air-gapped environment; (ii) We present the first protocol for covert thermal communication; (iii) We show how this channel can be exploited to send a message from a computer in an isolated network to the Internet.

• An attacker may use a compromised AC system to send commands to hosts in the target network, • We propose a novel protocol that allows the attacker to send commands over the thermal channel, • We provide experimental results which prove the feasibility of this attack, • We offer a forensic analysis of the thermal channel and propose various ways that this channel may be detected and prevented.

a new attack vector that can bridge an air gap, namely, the use of an air-conditioning system to send commands to a computer within an air-gaped network.

a new adversarial scenario, in which an attacker has infected a host within a secure network, and the attacker's main goal is to command and control this infected host.
